name: two-sided
selection_rule: User: remove bottom cyan spike; include left red crossing and right yellow.

name: duplicate
selection_rule: User: upper black reflection good, lower secondary. Compare the red right of upper black.

name: abstention
selection_rule: User: magenta outline very wrong; redesign native support.

name: auto-red
selection_rule: Highest solidity × min(area,400) R283 high red crossing support; >180px from earlier cases. This selects established cues, not blind recall ground truth.

name: auto-yellow
selection_rule: Highest solidity × min(area,400) R283 high yellow crossing support; >180px from earlier cases. This selects established cues, not blind recall ground truth.

name: auto-black
selection_rule: Highest solidity × min(area,400) R283 high black near support; >180px from earlier cases. This selects established cues, not blind recall ground truth.

name: auto-opposite
selection_rule: First saved R283 disjoint opposite-side near pair >180px from earlier cases, stable saved order.

name: auto-three
selection_rule: Exactly three R283 high support-near IDs within ±16px arc and 65px Euclidean; maximize side diversity, then support area; >180px from earlier cases. Three candidates, not verified bodies.
